entries.b289a83ad9a6c448: The Segment Information section states that external revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,593 million for the concrete-related business and ¥42 million for real estate, totaling ¥7,636 million. The Risks section states that the concrete-related business depends heavily on public works by government agencies and that changes in government finances could adversely affect results, and the 'Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows' section states that disaster-prevention works remained firm due to the promotion of the National Resilience Plan.
entries.bb1855d410eb7eee: The section 'Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address, etc.' states that, as a manufacturer with a commitment to technology, the company will undertake research and technology development to develop and commercialize new products and construction methods and to further improve quality, raise efficiency and expand applications of existing products and methods. The section 'Research and Development Activities' states that joint research and development with other companies to expand the applications of its products continues, centered on the technical design and development department. The section 'Business Description' lists products including Hume pipes, box culverts, connect holes, common utility ducts, utility-line ducts, Tēru Arume, home garages, earthquake-resistant fire-prevention water tanks and rainwater storage tanks.
